mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, accepted_member.project_member_id AS projectMemberId, pp.project_phase_id AS phaseId, pp.phase_order AS phaseOrder, pp.phase_name AS phaseName, pp.phase_objective AS phaseObjective, pp.phase_outcome AS phaseOutcome, pp.exit_criteria AS exitCriteria, pp.status AS phaseStatus, pps.project_phase_scope_id AS phaseScopeId, pps.scope_order AS scopeOrder, pps.scope AS scope, pm.project_milestone_id AS milestoneId, pm.milestone_name AS milestoneName, pm.milestone_intent AS milestoneIntent, pm.trigger_condition AS triggerCondition, pm.expected_state AS expectedState, pm.completion_rule AS completionRule, pm.status AS milestoneStatus, pmoe.project_milestone_observable_evidence_id AS observableEvidenceId, pmoe.evidence_order AS evidenceOrder, pmoe.evidence AS evidence FROM projects p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MIN(project_member_id) AS project_member_id FROM project_member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND response = 'ACCEPTED' GROUP BY project_id ) accepted_member ON accepted_member.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN project_phase pp ON pp.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN project_phase_scope pps ON pps.project_phase_id = pp.project_phase_id LEFT JOIN project_milestone pm ON pm.phase_id = pp.project_phase_id AND pm.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN project_milestone_observable_evidence pmoe ON pmoe.project_milestone_id = pm.project_milestone_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pp.phase_order ASC, pp.project_phase_id ASC, pps.scope_order ASC, pps.project_phase_scope_id ASC, pm.project_milestone_id ASC, pmoe.evidence_order ASC, pmoe.project_milestone_observable_evidence_id ASC
